6171.title: Pooled Codex launch retains native authentication
6171.rootCauseOneLine: The pooled Codex child is launched with requires_openai_auth=true alongside the hub-token header; routing does not establish hub-token-only authentication.
6171.proposedFix: Design and verify routed-only credential isolation across providers and nested commands while preserving native authentication for unrouted sessions. No automatic fix: authentication and security-boundary changes are excluded from the simple-fix policy.
6171.caveats: Two clean runs reproduce the Codex launch configuration through the real bridge and a repository-owned child test double. Actual upstream credential loading, refreshing, file writes, analytics, and nested CLIs were not exercised. The exact reproduction patch and output are inline in the report; raw artifacts remain local under reports repository privacy rules.
